title: Electric Daisy Carnival 2010 Video Compilation (EDC) Dallas, TX - June 2010 [HD 1080]
description:
This video is a compilation of some of the footage that I took at Electric Daisy Carnival (EDC) in Dallas, Texas on June 19, 2010.  Please watch the video in 1080 HD quality.  This was an epic event for Dallas so I decided I would create an epic video about it!  If you like what you see, please subscribe to my channel.  I will be uploading additional footage from that evening to my account within the following week.  

DALLAS LOVES EDC!  PLEASE BRING IT BACK NEXT YEAR!!

First Song: Human Resource - Dominator (Jaimie Fanatic Remix)
Second Song:  The Bloody Beetroots feat. Steve Aoki - Warp 1.9
